payload.summary: Implemented, adversarially reviewed, and integrated the registry-v2 root plus the generic feature-HEAD preflight barrier. The live gate remains blocked because the authoritative prerequisite changes do not expose the declared implementation surfaces, so no dependent package was dispatched.
completed_work: Implemented the exact-generation evidence barrier and callback-only, idempotent, under-lock dependent dispatch protocol.
Implemented and squash-integrated registry v2, fenced lifecycle operations, crash-safe recovery, schema-equivalent validation, migration compatibility, and conservative activity guards.
Passed 77 focused preflight tests and 187 registry/worktree tests on the combined feature branch, plus Ruff, strict OpenSpec, work-package overlap, scope, and diff checks.
Obtained clean independent implementation verdicts for both root packages after adversarial concurrency, provenance, crash-boundary, and schema-differential review.
in_progress: Task 0.5: generate and commit baseline-gates.json after both authoritative prerequisite implementations are merged and visible on the feature branch.

decisions.title: Keep dependent dispatch fail-closed
decisions.rationale: PR #235 lacks the declared merge-plan implementation files at its authoritative merge SHA, and no PR exists for the validation-findings prerequisite; creating dependent worktrees would violate the exact feature-HEAD gate.

decisions.title: Publish recovery evidence and ownership in one fenced critical section
decisions.rationale: Serializing quarantine revalidation, evidence publication, and registry authority prevents competing adopters from corrupting the winning fence while keeping network and process discovery outside the lock.
